description: Synthetic local-only fixtures; labels defined before tuning. Folder scope represented by server-resolved authorized file ID subset.

processing.text: Original documents are stored privately in Amazon S3. MiniLM embeddings and Qwen answer generation run on the local laptop. Local semantic retrieval does not need an AWS vector query.

borealis.text: Project Borealis uses violet balloons. Its synthetic access number is 914. The Borealis review is scheduled for 18 March 2027.

north.text: Policy North retains audit logs for 30 days. North requires two reviewers before publishing a release. The North retention policy was approved on 5 January 2026.

south.text: Policy South retains audit logs for 90 days. South requires three reviewers before publishing a release. The South retention policy was approved on 9 February 2026.

water.text: Rainwater harvesting collects rain from rooftops in storage tanks. Drip irrigation delivers water directly to plant roots and reduces evaporation. Repairing leaking taps prevents household water waste.

solar.text: Project Aurora uses photovoltaic panels to turn sunlight into electricity. Its annual renewable energy target is 73 megawatt hours. Battery storage supplies power after sunset.

expense.text: Employees must submit travel expense claims within 14 days of returning. Each claim must include itemized receipts. The reimbursement limit is 450 credits per journey.

backup.text: A full database backup runs every Sunday at 02:00 UTC. Incremental backups run nightly. Recovery snapshots are retained for 21 days. The recovery time objective is four hours.

security.text: Refresh tokens rotate after use. Reusing an old refresh token revokes its token family. Logout immediately revokes the active session. Passwords are stored as salted hashes.

queue.text: The ingestion queue visibility timeout is 180 seconds. Failed messages move to the dead-letter queue after three receives. Operators inspect failed messages before any approved replay. Never purge unknown messages.

api.text: The status endpoint is GET /status and requires AWS_IAM authentication with SigV4 signing. Unsigned status requests return HTTP 403. The client error code NV-409 indicates a revision conflict.

release.text: Release Cedar version 2.4.1 has a deadline of 12 April 2027. The release owner is Mira Patel. The final checklist requires passing tests, a verified backup and approval by two reviewers.

library.text: Library books may be borrowed for 28 days. Students may renew each book once if nobody has reserved it. Lost books must be reported to the circulation desk.

network.text: DNS translates domain names into IP addresses. TLS encrypts data in transit. An HTTP 429 response means the client exceeded the request rate limit.

food.text: The campus cafe serves lentil soup on Tuesdays and vegetable pasta on Fridays. Breakfast is available from 08:00 until 10:30. A reusable cup earns a 10 percent discount.
